product_overview: Ellipa is a B2B SaaS platform that combines a public marketing site with authentication and a private dashboard for authenticated users. It helps prospective customers explore pricing and solutions, create accounts, sign in, book demos, and try a sandbox simulation inside the dashboard.
core_goals: Browse the public marketing pages to learn about Ellipa’s pricing, process, solutions, and enterprise offering
Create a new user account and access the authenticated dashboard
Sign in to an existing account and reach the dashboard
Book a demo request from the dashboard
Run the sandbox simulation to view a staged automation log output
Use the auth-aware navigation to move between public pages and the dashboard

features.name: Public Marketing Site Navigation
features.description: Users can explore the public-facing pages and use the auth-aware navbar to move between key sections of the site.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the landing page content -> Use the navigation links to open Pricing, Process, Solutions, or Enterprise pages -> Return to the homepage
Navigate to /pricing -> Review the pricing tiers and comparison table -> Use a pricing CTA to continue to signup or enterprise contact
Navigate to /process -> Review the process overview page
Navigate to /solutions -> Review the solutions overview page
Navigate to /enterprise -> Review the enterprise features page

features.name: User Sign In
features.description: Existing users can sign in with email and password, or use the Google sign-in option.
user_flows: Navigate to /signin -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> See a successful redirect to /dashboard
Navigate to /signin -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the form -> See an inline sign-in error message
Navigate to /signin -> Choose the Google sign-in option -> Complete the OAuth popup flow -> See a successful redirect to /dashboard

features.name: User Registration
features.description: New users can create an account with name, work email, and password, or use the Google sign-up option.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter name -> Enter work email -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> See the account creation success screen with the dashboard continuation option
Navigate to /signup -> Enter a test email or bypass-qualified name -> Submit the form -> See the success screen without waiting for external authentication
Navigate to /signup -> Choose the Google sign-up option -> Complete the OAuth popup flow -> Continue to the dashboard after successful account creation

features.name: Authenticated Dashboard
features.description: Signed-in users can view a personalized workspace with KPI cards and quick actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See the personalized greeting -> View the KPI stats cards -> Open Solutions from the quick actions
Navigate to /dashboard -> See the personalized greeting -> View the KPI stats cards -> Open the demo booking modal
Navigate to /dashboard -> See the personalized greeting -> View the KPI stats cards -> Start the sandbox simulation -> Watch the progressive log output appear

features.name: Book a Demo Request
features.description: Authenticated users can open a demo booking modal, submit their details, and receive a confirmation state.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the demo booking modal -> Enter name -> Enter work email -> Enter company -> Enter message -> Submit the form -> See the request submitted confirmation
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the demo booking modal -> Enter details -> Submit the form -> See the confirmation text include the submitted name and email -> Close the modal to reset the form
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the demo booking modal -> Dismiss the modal by closing it or clicking outside it -> Return to the dashboard

features.name: Auth-Aware Navigation State
features.description: The navbar changes based on whether the user is signed in or signed out.
user_flows: Navigate to a public page -> View Sign In and Get Started actions in the navbar -> Open Sign In or Sign Up from the navbar
Sign in successfully -> Return to a page with the navbar -> View the authenticated greeting -> View Dashboard and Log Out actions
While authenticated -> Use Log Out from the navbar -> See the session end and return to the homepage

features.name: Pricing and Conversion CTAs
features.description: Users can compare plans and follow call-to-action paths into signup or enterprise contact.
user_flows: Navigate to /pricing -> Review Starter, Professional, and Enterprise plans -> Compare the feature table -> Choose a plan CTA to continue
Navigate to /pricing -> Select the Starter plan CTA -> Continue to the signup flow with the starter plan context
Navigate to /pricing -> Select the Professional trial CTA -> Continue to the signup flow with the professional plan context
Navigate to /pricing -> Select the Enterprise contact CTA -> Open the enterprise contact path

features.name: Sandbox Simulator
features.description: Authenticated users can start a scripted simulation and watch log lines appear progressively.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Start the sandbox simulation -> Watch log entries appear one by one -> See the simulation complete

routes.description: Home/landing page with hero section, Spline 3D viewer, ScrollVelocity ticker, founder section, and Book Demo CTA
Pricing tiers - Starter ($499), Professional ($1299), Enterprise (Custom) with feature comparison table
How Ellipa works - step-by-step process overview page
Platform solutions page with Spline 3D viewer and feature highlights
Enterprise-grade features page with contact CTA and Spline 3D viewer
User sign-in via email/password or Google OAuth. Bypass hook - email 'example@gmail.com' skips Firebase.
New user registration via email/password or Google OAuth. Bypass - email containing 'autotest' skips Firebase.
Authenticated user workspace with welcome banner, KPI stats, Book Demo button, and Sandbox Simulator

features.name: User Sign In
features.description: Sign in with email and password or Google OAuth
user_interactions: Navigate to /signin
Fill email input field (#email)
Fill password input field (#password)
Click Sign In button (button[type=submit])
Optionally click Sign in with Google button
See error message on invalid credentials
Redirect to /dashboard on success

features.name: User Registration (Sign Up)
features.description: Create a new account with name, work email, and password or Google OAuth
user_interactions: Navigate to /signup
Fill Name input field
Fill Work Email input field
Fill Password input field
Click Create Enterprise Account button
See success screen with Check your email heading
Click Continue to Dashboard button
Redirect to /dashboard on success

features.name: Dashboard - Authenticated Workspace
features.description: Personalized dashboard for authenticated users with KPI stats and quick actions
user_interactions: View personalized greeting (Hello [name] or Hey! there [email prefix])
View 4 KPI stat cards (Active Pipelines, Tasks Run, Uptime, API Calls)
Click Explore Solutions button to navigate to /solutions
Click Book a Demo button to open demo modal
Click Run Sandbox Simulation button to start log animation
View progressive simulation log output

features.name: Book a Demo Modal
features.description: Demo booking form that saves data to Firestore bookings collection
user_interactions: Click Book a Demo button to open modal
Fill Name input in modal
Fill Work Email input in modal
Fill Company input in modal
Fill Message textarea in modal
Click Submit button
See Request Submitted! success confirmation
View submitted name and email in confirmation text
Click Close button or backdrop to dismiss and reset modal

features.name: Navigation - Auth-Aware Navbar
features.description: Navbar changes content based on authentication state
user_interactions: View Sign In and Get Started buttons when unauthenticated
View Hey! there [username] greeting when authenticated
View Dashboard and Log Out buttons when authenticated
Click Log Out to sign out and redirect to /
Click navigation links (Pricing, Process, Solutions, Enterprise)

features.name: Pricing Page
features.description: Three-tier pricing with feature comparison table and CTAs
user_interactions: View Starter tier ($499/month)
View Professional tier ($1299/month) marked as MOST POPULAR
View Enterprise tier (Custom pricing)
Click Choose Starter to navigate to /signup?plan=starter
Click Start Professional Trial to navigate to /signup?plan=professional
Click Contact Sales to navigate to /enterprise
View feature comparison table with Starter/Professional/Enterprise columns
Click Get Started Now CTA at bottom

features.name: Sandbox Simulator
features.description: Animated demo log output simulating automation pipeline execution
user_interactions: Click Run Sandbox Simulation button
View progressive log output appearing line by line
See simulation completion state

known_limitations.issue: Google OAuth sign-in requires real browser popup interaction - cannot be fully automated
known_limitations.impact: Google sign-in tests should use bypass hooks instead

known_limitations.issue: Actual Firestore writes require valid Firebase project credentials and security rules
known_limitations.impact: Modal gracefully shows success even if Firestore write fails - test the UI state not the DB write

known_limitations.issue: Spline 3D viewer is a third-party embedded element that may not load in headless environments
known_limitations.impact: Tests should verify page renders without blocking on Spline viewer load

known_limitations.issue: Dashboard requires Firebase Auth - use test bypass email example@gmail.com to skip real auth
known_limitations.impact: Use example@gmail.com to access dashboard in automated tests
